UMB Director Mr. Tee Lip Zhun, the CEO of UMB and Deputy COO Encik Nazaruddin of Far East Holding joined the PA visit on 19 August. 4-month drought at the PA visit.

AREA (PA section 2): title 4,483.38 ha. Mature 1,000.73 ha (22.32%), immature 449.61 ha (10.03%), total oil palm 1,450.34 ha (32.35%). Non-cultivated 3,033.04 ha: overhead cable/drain 46.77, ex PLG 29.25, building sites and roads 92.76, vacant plantable 1,733.04, vacant unplantable 1,131.22. No change in area. The last 35 ha of the 173 ha rehabilitation was finished in April 2026; 177 ha is to be rehabilitated in FY2026/27, 69 ha done by August, 108 ha by April 2027. Of the 1,000.73 ha declared mature only 589 ha was productive (PA 2.4). Agronomy Table 1 by planting year: 2013 353.85 ha, 2014 74.16, 2018 88.41, 2019 375.43, 2020 410.23 (Table 2: 410.32), 2023 47.63, 2024 85.49, 2025 15.05, total 1,450.34. 167 sub-blocks averaging 8.7 ha (2025 planting 12 sub-blocks of 1.3 ha). About 54% of the area is young mature (4 to 7 years), 36% prime mature, 10% immature; no old plantings, P13 the oldest, no replanting needed. Sub-block consolidation still not done (Agro).

PALM DENSITY (Agro Table 3, 4): 169,438 palms on 1,450.3 ha; table prints SPH 143, but this equals 117 palms per ha, the figure Agro 7.2(e) uses. Many P19 and P20 sub-blocks below 100 SPH and some nearly empty: AH80-20A1 1 SPH, AK76-20A1 3, AL71-20A1 3, AL77-20A1 3, AL72-20A1 9, AH79-19A1 17, AL77-19A1 26, AI79-20A1 31, AK80-19A1 40, AL71-18A1 45, AK79-19A1 58, AP07-19A1 69, AR09-13A1 70. Supplying on hold until Seluang nursery seedlings are ready; full census needed (Agro 2.10).

LABOUR (PA section 3, April 2026): total workers 154 vs requirement 102 (+52; last-month column 140). Harvesting 43 (41 harvester/carriers + 2 FFB lorry) vs 60 required; manuring 6 vs 11; spraying 32 vs 23; pruners 3; mandore 12 vs 8; general workers 58 (12 general, 5 tractor drivers, 18 nursery, 7 gate security, 3 night watchmen, 9 AST/Damkar/WMS/QM, 4 clerks). Harvesters needed 60 at 1:17 ha on 1,000 ha; text says 45 available in April (1:22). On the 589 productive ha only 33 are needed (1:18) and 35 were on hand in August, judged adequate. Seluang Estate workers helped with manuring; estate told to recruit its own. Worker ratio 1:9 ha, satisfactory. Staff unchanged: EM, Asisten Kepala Rafael Raya (from 1 Jan 2026), two division assistants, KTU.

GENERAL CHARGES (PA section 5, 12 months to April 2026): RM2,309,158 vs budget RM998,254 (+131%), RM1,592/ha vs RM654/ha on 1,450.34 ha planted. Staff costs RM211,487 vs 245,727 (-14%). Labour overhead RM402,408 vs 361,649 (+11%): labour wages RM258,325 vs 213,950 (+21%, unbudgeted mosque watchman, office boy and fire-control watchman). Office and related RM466,047 vs 370,254 (+26%): MSPO/sustainability RM40,772 vs RM742 (+5,396%, ISPO auditor meetings and mandatory safety clothing), water and electricity RM154,100 vs 72,241 (+113%, mill allocation), land and building tax RM163,177 vs 76,240 (+114%, Head Office allocation), transport and travelling RM2,017 vs 1,382 (+46%, Estate Manager trip to China in April), security RM31,888 vs 89,025, insurance RM11,786 vs 33,265. The President Director accepted the overspend as justified; PA asks for a more accurate budget.

UPKEEP AND CULTIVATION (PA section 6, mature 1,000.73 ha, FFB 10,630 t): RM2,907,467 vs RM2,633,489 (+10%), RM2,905/ha vs 2,632, RM274/t vs 249. Lines (RM; RM/ha; RM/t actual vs budget): supervision 46,345 vs 58,075; weeding 255,069 vs 201,364 (255 vs 201/ha, +27%); manuring 1,013,027 vs 1,617,702 (1,012 vs 1,617/ha, RM95 vs 153/t, -37%); composting 281,439 vs 238,595; pests and diseases 17,400 vs 13,972; census and thinning 10,337 vs 14,722; drains 354,754 vs 110,805 (+220%); roads and bridges 696,488 vs 144,963 (+380%, capital items charged to opex on Head Office instruction); soil/water conservation 118,261 vs 28,589 (+314%); supplying 54,220 vs 76,659; pruning 51,547 vs 110,173 (-53%); tools 5,650 vs 3,040.

WEEDING (PA): circle spraying 2,596 ha (2.6 rounds), 86% of 3,002 ha (3 rounds) to April; circles generally clean so some rounds deferred. High-volume CKS, 3.1 ha/man-day, 18 pumps a day, about 6 hours worked (village workers); piece rate RM14.44/ha, earnings RM44.76/day vs basic RM33.45.
